content: आपूपिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [अपूप-ठक्] .²1 A good maker of अपूप (cakes). .²2 Accustomed to eat cakes. .²3 Fond of cakes, eating cakes (with benefit). .²4 Selling cakes. .²5 Baking cakes. .²6 Forming an ingredient of cakes, good for cakes (as गुड). .{@-कः@} A baker; confectioner. .{@-कम्@} A multitude of cakes (अपूपानां समूहः).
